title: WWII in HD
description:
S01 E06 — Point of No Return
U.S. Marines battle for Peleliu in the Pacific; the Allies race toward Germany. Narrator: Gary Sinise.

title: Mail Call
description:
S01 E08 — Revolutionary War Musket; Jousting; Foxholes
How fast a Revolutionary War soldier could fire a musket; jousting; how to dig a foxhole.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S02 E10 — Tabar
Four bladesmiths take an ordinary garden lawnmower and use its metal to create one of their signature blades; two will make it to the final round during which they must forge a Tabar, a battle-ax from Southern Asia.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S01 E05 — Crusader Sword
Following a difficult first round of testing, the remaining two bladesmiths head home with only five days to forge the legendary Crusader Sword.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S02 E05 — Viking Sword
In a race against time, four bladesmiths have to salvage material from a car and forge a blade; two will make it to the final round where they will have just five days to create a Viking sword.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S01 E06 — The Elizabethan Rapier
The bladesmiths have to use an age-old technique to make their signature weapons; two finalists head to their home forges to create one of history's most notorious weapons, the rapier.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S02 E03 — The Scottish Claymore
Four blade smiths face grueling challenges when the electricity and power tools are taken away from them; only two will survive and move on to the final round where they'll have just five days to create the iconic Scottish Claymore.

title: Forged in Fire: Beat the Judges
description:
S01 E01 — Short Sword Damascus
Three champions return to the forge, hoping to defeat one of the three judges; after forging signature blades and a Khanda, one champion survives to enter their toughest challenge yet, competing against a judge.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S01 E04 — Katar
Competitors make their signature blade by using the Hada technique, a traditional process that involves forging multiple layers of steel together.

title: Top Shot
description:
S02 E04 — Compound Fracture
The contestants' archery skills are put to the test with a modern compound bow; tubular team challenge; tensions with team leadership threaten to unravel the group.

title: Top Shot
description:
S02 E05 — Quickfire Face-Off
Head-to-head speed-shooting showdown; the contestants get surprise visitors to help train.

title: Top Shot
description:
S02 E06 — Bury the Hatchet
Marksmen compete with the tomahawk and blowgun; one of the most intense challenges of the season shows who has natural skills and adaptability and who doesn't.

description:
S02 E07 — Trick Shot Showdown II
Contestants split a bullet on an axe; iconic shots from exhibition shooting history.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S16 E02 — Triple Crown Pawn
Corey bets it all on an original Triple Crown trophy; the guys call in Rick Dale to save what may be one of the very first rides from Coney Island; a Civil War relic causes a divide between Rick and a customer.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S03 E01 — Peeping Pawn
The team is presented with a rare 1776 Massachusetts penny made by Paul Revere; Rick has an opportunity to buy a hand grenade made by an American World War II spy program; Rick and Corey meet a man hoping to sell his 1950s peep show machine.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S03 E06 — Ready, Set, Pawn
A seller brings in a competition dragster racecar; Rick and Corey are presented with a Japanese land mine training kit used during World War II; Corey and Chumlee check out a fully restored 1957 Dr. Pepper vending machine.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S17 E16 — Across the Pawn'd
Rick shoots over to England for an explosive chance to test out antique weapons; an item that inspired a classic movie rifles into the shop; Rick gets a look at a classic car that belonged to Winston Churchill.

title: American Pickers
description:
War & Picks
Mike and Frank hit the road in search of military items of historical interest.

title: American Pickers
description:
S09 E08 — Traders of the Lost Parts
The guys scour an extraordinary New Jersey collection; Mike finds a rare 1911 Harley motor he needs to complete a project; Dave's heavenly stockpile.

title: American Pickers
description:
S06 E03 — Mike's Holy Grail
The guys get a vague lead on the holy grail of motorbikes; Mike puts pressure on Danielle to track down a XAVW; Betty's sprawling warehouses; Dale's awesome junkyard and a noble cause.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S03 E26 — Wise Guys
The Pawn Stars are presented with a fully functional 1941 M3 Armored Scout Truck from World War II; Rick and Corey meet a man hoping to sell a check signed by notorious mobster Carlo Gambino; Rick and Chumlee check out a 1987 Apple II GS Computer.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S11 E14 — Live Long and Prosper
An Eli Whitney Civil War revolver comes into the shop; Corey checks out a signed picture of the original Star Trek cast; Corey unfriends Chumlee on social media, so Chumlee decides to unfriend Corey in real life.

title: FDR
description:
S01 E01 — Nothing to Fear
Franklin D. Roosevelt overcomes crushing personal setbacks and leads the nation through the Great Depression with optimism, energy and a firm belief that the only thing one has to fear is fear itself.

title: FDR
description:
S01 E02 — Rendezvous With Destiny
As Hitler sweeps across Europe, FDR prepares a reluctant nation for war; following the devastating attack on Pearl Harbor, he leads America into the greatest conflict the world has ever seen.

title: FDR
description:
S01 E03 — Arsenal of Democracy
Franklin rallies the industrial might of the nation and leads the Allied forces through the darkest days of the war.

title: History's Crazy Rich Ancients
description:
S01 E05 — Maximum Security
No problem has loomed larger for history's crazy rich than how to keep themselves and their multi-million dollar homes safe and secure; these three figures broke the bank on security features designed to prevent break-ins.
